task.title: Running a standalone Red Hat Quay deployment in debug mode
task.shortdesc: To run a standalone Red Hat Quay deployment in debug mode and get verbose logging for troubleshooting, you can use podman run with DEBUGLOG=true. View debug output with the podman logs command.
